page_title: BOC 0-5 LEV | Bochum v Bayer Leverkusen 12/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' 0 - 5 Goal! Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) fires home from very close range after latching on to a pass from Josip Stanisic. The score is 0:5.
90+1' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

89' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Manuel Riemann pulls off a brilliant save. Bayer Leverkusen force a corner. They send men into the box.
86' 0 - 4 Josip Stanisic (Bayer Leverkusen) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box. The ball goes into the bottom right corner and past the goalkeeper.

86' Ambitious effort from Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.

85' Bayer Leverkusen are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
83' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Manuel Riemann comes off his line to intercept.
80' The linesman raises his flag. Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) is adjudged offside.
79' Xabi Alonso has decided to make a change. Gustavo Puerta (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Granit Xhaka.
79' Nathan Tella comes off the pitch to be replaced by Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen).
79' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) has a goal ruled out for offside!
78' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) is about to take a corner kick.
78' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner.
77' 0 - 3 Jonas Hofmann takes over corner duties and expertly finds Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header into the back of the net. The score is now 0:3.
76' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

76' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bayer Leverkusen.
75' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lukas Hradecky intercepts the ball.
73' Bayer Leverkusen control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
72' Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) is penalised for a foul. Benjamin Brand had a clear view and blows his whistle.
71' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
69' Here is a change. Patrik Schick is going off and Xabi Alonso gives the last tactical orders to Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen).
69' Substitution. Borja Iglesias (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Victor Boniface.

68' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
67' CHANCE! Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he sends his shot well wide of the left post.
66' Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
64' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) spanks one well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
64' It's time for a substitution. Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on in place of Odilon Kossounou.
63' Benjamin Brand shows a yellow card to Ivan Ordets (Bochum), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
61' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot on goal, but the ball curls just wide of the right post.
61' Heiko Butscher has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lukas Daschner (Bochum) replacing Philipp Hofmann.
61' A substitution has been made. Anthony Losilla is replaced by Matus Bero (Bochum).
59' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) blows a great chance. He unleashes a shot from inside the box, but the effort rattles the left post. The goalkeeper can remain calm.
58' Neat passing move from Bayer Leverkusen in order to create new attacking opportunities.
56' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
54' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
53' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for a foul.

51' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Manuel Riemann anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the bottom right corner.
50' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender.
49' Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a short corner kick.
49' Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bayer Leverkusen.
48' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
46' Heiko Butscher decides to make a substitution. Bernardo will be replaced by Erhan Masovic (Bochum).
46' Benjamin Brand blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' 0 - 2 GOAL! Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) strikes the penalty low down the middle and scores after the ball glances off the leg of Manuel Riemann.
45+2' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
45+1' Benjamin Brand shows the yellow card to Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum) for a heavy challenge.
45+1' Benjamin Brand blows the whistle, Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum) is penalised for a foul. The referee uncompromisingly points to the spot and it's a penalty to Bayer Leverkusen.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
43' The ball is cleared after Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
41' 0 - 1 What a hit! Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot inside the right post. 0:1.
40' Odilon Kossounou (Bayer Leverkusen) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.

39' Bayer Leverkusen hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
37' Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) slips through the defence and passes the ball in from the edge of the box. Patrik Schick picks it up but loses it to one of the defenders.
36' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar.
36' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
33' Odilon Kossounou (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
31' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the crossbar. Close!
31' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
30' Josip Stanisic (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The ball is out of play. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner kick.
29' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
28' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
27' The foul by Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Benjamin Brand.
24' Odilon Kossounou (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Benjamin Brand has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
23' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the right post!
21' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) is flagged for offside.
20' Substitution. Tim Oermann (Bochum) on for Takuma Asano.
19' A pass from Takuma Asano (Bochum) is intercepted by Lukas Hradecky and the move breaks down.
18' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
17' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen).
15' Felix Passlack (Bochum) makes a reckless challenge on his opponent and is shown a red card without any hesitation from the referee!
14' Benjamin Brand has a clear sight and sees a foul from Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum).
12' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
12' The corner finds Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) unmarked but his close-range header is poor and slips well wide of the left post.
12' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
10' Takuma Asano (Bochum) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out of play and Bochum have been awarded a corner kick.
9' Takuma Asano (Bochum) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
9' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
7' Bernardo (Bochum) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
6' Felix Passlack (Bochum) sends a long ball in, but Lukas Hradecky comfortably gathers the ball.
5' Lukas Hradecky leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Kevin Stoger (Bochum).

4' Felix Passlack (Bochum) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball goes out of play. Bochum are awarded a corner kick.
3' Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
3' Felix Passlack (Bochum) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
2' A cross into the box from Kevin Stoger (Bochum) is cleared.
1' The match has just started.
Bochum will kick-off.
Benjamin Brand is the one to supervise the game today.
